title: Product/Project Manager
description:

The Product/Project Manager drives the program from MVP to GA. You own the backlog and plan, keep a cross-functional technical team aligned on milestones, manage risks and dependencies, and provide clear delivery reporting to ComTek-side stakeholders.

**Product**

* **GA definition:** Define the GA scope, exit criteria and readiness checklist (security, performance, billing, migration, support).

* **Change control:** Manage scope changes and decision records with the Tech Architect.

* 7+ years in product or project management with SaaS experience.

* Agile delivery at scale; Jira or similar.

* Experience managing technically complex programmes involving cloud, data and AI.

* Customer migration programmes.

* PMP, CSM, SAFe or similar certification.

* Program plan, roadmap and milestone tracker.

* Weekly delivery reports; RAID log.

* GA readiness checklist and cutover plan.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business or equivalent; MBA a plus.

Die Position
  
  
Job description
  
We are looking for a Project Manager / Scrum Master (CSV& Compliance) to drive the end-to-end delivery of validated computerized system implementations, upgrades, and migrations. In this hybrid role, you will balance traditional project management governance (scope, budget, timeline, and vendor oversight) and active Scrum Master facilitation with deep hands-on oversight of CSV/CSA lifecycles under GxP regulations. You will serve as the central bridge connecting business owners, technical engineering squads, and Quality Assurance, ensuring rapid iterative delivery without compromising regulatory compliance.
  
  
As a Delivery Management Professional, you independently manage less complex deliveries, solve problems within your scope, build stakeholder relationships, and begin to align your work with broader objectives while supporting team development. You will take ownership of clearly defined tasks, smaller projects, or initiatives, and contribute to larger project scopes, operating across the Project Manager and Scrum Master role archetypes.
  
Description of the area
  
  
This role sits within a delivery organization responsible for implementing, upgrading, and migrating GxP-regulated computerized systems. You will work with business owners, technical engineering squads, Quality Assurance, and external vendors to deliver validated solutions iteratively while maintaining audit and inspection readiness.
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Takes ownership of clearly defined, less complex tasks, smaller projects, or initiatives within their area of responsibility, including validated system implementations, upgrades, and migrations. Assists in outlining and documenting the scope for larger projects, pinpointing key components (including validation scope and GxP impact), and starting to identify and flag potential scope-affecting issues. Supports and contributes to the management of minor scope changes, understanding their basic impact on delivery and validation status, and actively participates in scope-related discussions. Maintains and refines the product backlog so that validation and compliance activities are planned alongside functional work. Contributes to the definition of product roadmaps or service improvement plans upon request and supports team members in understanding a clear, manageable scope.
* Delivery Governance: Applies traditional project management governance to assigned initiatives, including planning, milestone tracking, risk and issue management, and status reporting. Provides day-to-day oversight of tracking deliverables, quality of work, and adherence to agreed timelines and quality requirements. Escalates deviations from scope or timeline early, with proposed options for resolution.
* Scrum Master Facilitation: Actively facilitates Scrum events (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives) for technical engineering squads. Coaches the team on Agile practices, removes impediments, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement. Adapts Agile ways of working to a regulated environment so that iterative delivery produces the documented evidence required for compliance (for example, embedding validation tasks and acceptance criteria into the definition of done).
* CSV/CSA Lifecycle Oversight (GxP Compliance): Provides hands-on oversight of Computer System Validation (CSV) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) activities across the system lifecycle under GxP regulations. Coordinates the creation, review, and approval of validation deliverables such as validation plans, risk assessments, requirements and traceability matrices, test strategies and test summary reports, and validation summary reports.
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Independently analyzes less complex delivery and compliance problems within assigned areas, helping to identify root causes and eliciting stakeholder needs with less supervision. Owns problem-solving plans within scope, defines and presents solutions, and breaks down challenges. Applies independent analysis to identify discrepancies (including gaps in validation documentation or traceability), question assumptions, and propose improvements. Proactively reaches out for help when needed, supports team development, builds trust with product teams/peers, and contributes to discussions.
* Impact/Strategy: Contributes to projects or workgroups within a specified area and may participate, support, or lead moderate-size projects. Efforts directly support achieving targeted team or chapter-related outcomes. Identifies opportunities for minor process improvements within their immediate scope (for example, streamlining validation documentation or adopting risk-based CSA practices) and demonstrates growing autonomy and expertise. Supports planning and prioritization while aligning behaviors with the strategy of the organization.
* Complexity / (Product Size): Works on a product or larger context, managing small to medium-sized initiatives where the impact extends to a specific deliverable or feature. Handles moderately complex delivery tasks and requirements in a regulated environment, applies standard methodologies with some adaptation, and manages a moderate number of related deliverables. Interacts with stakeholders across the delivery team, QA, and vendors, managing stakeholders with moderate complexity.

Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Demonstrated experience in managing small to medium-sized initiatives, projects, or workstreams within a product or larger context, ideally in a GxP-regulated (e.g., pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences) environment.
* Hands-on experience with CSV and/or CSA lifecycles for the implementation, upgrade, or migration of computerized systems, including coordination of validation deliverables with Quality Assurance.
* Experience acting as a Scrum Master or Agile delivery lead for technical engineering squads, and applying project management governance (scope, budget, timeline) alongside Agile practices.
* Experience overseeing vendors or implementation partners.
* Experience independently analyzing less complex delivery problems, identifying root causes, and owning problem-solving plans.
* Proven ability to build rapport with stakeholders, facilitate meetings, and manage stakeholder expectations within a defined area of responsibility.

Technical / Business Skills
  
  

* Working knowledge of GxP regulations and related guidance, data integrity principles, and risk-based validation approaches, including CSA.
* Understands the business context for their deliverables, contributes to defining how delivery aligns with business needs, and applies business knowledge to problem-solving.
* Applies standard delivery methodologies (e.g., Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, hybrid approaches, ITIL) with increasing proficiency, and can tailor them to meet regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with change control, deviation/CAPA management, and requirements traceability practices.
* Capable of using a range of delivery tools and techniques (e.g., Jira, Confluence, and electronic quality or validation management systems) to manage delivery processes for small to medium-sized initiatives.
* Begins to identify business and process improvement opportunities within their immediate scope.

Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively build trust with product teams, QA, and peers.
* Demonstrates growing autonomy, supports planning and prioritization, and proactively reaches out for help when needed to address issues.
* Ability to balance rapid, iterative delivery with regulatory compliance and documentation rigor.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CSM/PSM) are an advantage.

Job Title

General Manager - Projects (API Pharma)

Job Description

General Manager – Projects (API Pharma) will be responsible for leading and managing end-to-end project activities for Greenfield and Brownfield API (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient) manufacturing facilities at Digwal locations. The incumbent will oversee all phases of the project lifecycle—conceptualization, design, engineering, procurement, construction, installation, commissioning, and handover—ensuring timely delivery, adherence to budget, and full compliance with cGMP, EHS, and regulatory standards.  
This role requires a highly skilled project management professional with a strong background in pharmaceutical engineering, process design, and cross-functional coordination, capable of managing complex projects while driving excellence in quality, safety, and cost-effectiveness.

### **General Manager – Projects (API Pharma)**

**Band:** 4  
**Department:** Global Engineering & Projects  
**Location:** Digwal  
**Reports To:** Sr. VP Global Head Project / Engg  
**Employment Type:** Full-time / Permanent

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning & Execution**

* Lead **end-to-end project management** for new API manufacturing facilities, plant expansions, and capacity enhancement projects.
* Develop and manage **project schedules, budgets, timelines, and resource plans** using tools such as **Primavera or MS Project**.
* Coordinate with **consultants, architects, and EPC contractors** for basic and detailed engineering, procurement, and construction activities.
* Drive **installation, commissioning, and qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ)** of process, utility, and ancillary systems.
* Ensure **on-time delivery** of projects within approved budgets and scope.

**2. Engineering & Technical Oversight**

* Review and approve **Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs)**, **Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)**, equipment data sheets, and layout drawings.
* Ensure engineering design adheres to **cGMP**, **USFDA**, **EMA**, **MHRA**, and **WHO** standards.
* Support **technology transfer**, **process scale-up**, and **equipment selection** in coordination with R&D and Manufacturing teams.
* Provide **technical leadership** in areas such as **utilities (WFI, clean steam, HVAC, chillers, compressed air)** and **cleanroom design**.

**3. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate closely with internal teams including **Production, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, EHS, and Procurement** for smooth execution.
* Work with **Finance and Procurement** for cost estimation, vendor selection, contract negotiation, and budget tracking.
* Lead **site-based project teams**, ensuring effective communication, accountability, and goal alignment.
* Build strong relationships with external partners, consultants, and suppliers to ensure best-in-class project delivery.

**4. Compliance, Quality & Safety**

* Ensure strict adherence to **EHS (Environment, Health & Safety)** and **Quality Management** standards throughout project execution.
* Conduct **Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOP)**, risk assessments, and implement mitigation strategies.
* Ensure all activities comply with **statutory, local, and international regulatory** requirements.
* Support readiness for **regulatory audits and inspections** related to project and facility setup.

**5. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare **comprehensive project reports**, including progress updates, risk analysis, and deviation reports, for senior management.
* Maintain **accurate documentation** as per GMP and project management protocols.
* Track project performance against defined **KPIs and milestones**, recommending corrective actions as needed.
* Present updates in **management review meetings** and provide visibility into project health and financial status.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

**Education:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in **Chemical Engineering**
* Project Management certification will be an added advantage.

**Experience:**

* Minimum **20 + years** of experience in **API or bulk drug project management**, preferably with leading pharmaceutical companies.
* Proven experience in executing **Greenfield and Brownfield projects** from concept to commissioning.
* Exposure to **Multiple Projects handling**
* Strong understanding of **GMP facility design**, **process equipment**, **utilities**, and **HVAC systems**.
* Familiarity with **international regulatory guidelines** – USFDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO.
* Proficiency in **project management tools** such as **Primavera, MS Project**, and **AutoCAD**.

### **Key Competencies & Skills**

* Strong **leadership and people management** skills; ability to lead cross-functional teams.
* Excellent **communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management** capabilities.
* Strategic thinker with a **hands-on execution approach**.
* Strong **analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making** abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to **manage budgets, timelines, and multiple priorities** under pressure.
* Commitment to **quality, safety, and regulatory compliance**.
* Willingness to **travel extensively** (domestic and international) based on project needs.

### **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of projects within approved budget and scope.
* Compliance with regulatory, safety, and quality standards.
* Effective vendor and contractor management.
* Achievement of project milestones and financial targets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional collaboration effectiveness.

  
Bachelor of Engineering (Chemical) (Inactive)

**The Role**


We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  

  

This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  

  

You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co\-located, and there isn't always a well\-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  

  

Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  

  

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

* Drive end\-to\-end technology programs — translate high\-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third\-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non\-co\-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross\-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.


Ability to operate in a high\-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high\-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
